figurative_meaning_bn: কারো দোষ না দেখা বা পক্ষপাতদুষ্ট হওয়া
figurative_meaning_en: Not seeing someone's faults or being biased due to favoritism
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার বাবা তার দোষগুলো দেখতে অন্ধ হয়ে গেছে।
পক্ষপাতের কারণে সে নিরপেক্ষতা হারিয়ে অন্ধ হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: His father has become blind to all his faults.
Due to bias, she has turned blind to the truth.
history: References Dhritarashtra from the Mahabharata epic, who was metaphorically blind due to excessive affection for his sons, ignoring their wrongdoings.
note: The idiom draws from Hindu mythology, emphasizing parental or personal bias.
